full_scientific_text_read.method: Complete extracted text was actually read in this scientific Chat; extraction/parsing alone was not counted as scientific reading.

hypotheses: Finite real R^L, 1<=N<L; real rank-N projectors; coordinate fragments partition L and each Lx<N.
Only h=h^T and real pair-Hermitian V_abcd=V_cdab are explicitly stated.
A1: epsilon_N<0<epsilon_N+1. A2: occupied and virtual fragment images have maximal rank Lx, forcing Lx<=min(N,L-N).
A3: Bd restricted to tangent projectors is onto symmetric block-diagonal trace-zero Y. A4: the true frozen-impurity response is invertible on Y.
theorem_scope: Proposition 1 needs A1-A2 and gives the noninteracting fixed point.
Theorem 4 gives a unique local real-analytic branch for sufficiently small two-sided alpha and near D0, under A1-A4; no global uniqueness, uniform interval, or iteration convergence follows.
Theorem 5 is equality of first derivatives, with O(alpha^2) differences among DMET, exact, and HF densities; exact interacting densities need not be projectors.

coverage.subject: Compatibility, representation and commutant criteria
checks: Lemma 7: x^T D x=||Dx||^2 and complementary identity prove interior block eigenvalues versus both maximal ranks.
Impurity columns are orthonormal, occupied/virtual columns orthogonal, and core formula subtracts exactly the occupied impurity projector.

Two-fragment projector block equations CC^T=P1-P1^2, C^TC=P2-P2^2 and P1C+CP2=C give complementary fractional eigenvalues.
Lemma 11 follows from the kernel of the adjoint, hence tests surjectivity rather than injectivity.
coverage.outcome: Supporting arguments verified; Kadison reference is not a false-citation finding.

coverage.subject: Noninteracting consistency and chemical potential
checks: Compression to occupied/virtual impurity spaces preserves strictly negative/positive spectra.
The chemical potential zero yields the original density; charge derivative at zero is positive by A2.

Variational ground-state charge is globally nondecreasing in chemical potential, which with local strict increase excludes another root with equal target charge even if level crossings occur away from zero.
Spectral-projector derivative (54) checked for its negative response sign.

Replace displayed alpha*Cnl by |alpha|*Cnl for the advertised two-sided interval and retain a possible fixed local constant; these local bound corrections preserve localization.
Independent block calculation gives Hessian X -> h_plus X-X h_minus, positive with lower bound gamma.
Invertibility of [A B*; B 0] and derivative A^-1 B*(B A^-1 B*)^-1 checked.
coverage.outcome: Analytic LL proof verified after local bound corrections; no unsupported external-Hessian theorem substitution.

coverage.outcome: Problem 5 corrections required; corrected argument reconnected to the variationally defined map.

coverage.subject: First-order exactness
checks: Canonical CAR normalization and negative excitation denominators checked; the intermediate positive d1_ai displays require correction while equation77 has the correct overall sign.
The retained full six-dimensional perturbation calculation agrees with the actual printed W2 contractions under tensor normalization R1. The earlier contrary source attribution is withdrawn.
One-body observables couple the reference only to singles; doubles do not contribute at first order.
Core and occupied impurity density sum to D0, giving the same first-order effective interaction in exact/HF and the high-level variants.
Equal scalar charge derivatives, invertible residual and common LL derivative imply equal first-order densities.
Actual source image physical46 shows -mu(alpha) outside the alpha parentheses; the proposed factoring defect is withdrawn.
coverage.outcome: Problem5 retained only for the demonstrated Hamiltonian, half-factor, charge, CAR-normalization and intermediate-sign errors. Two unsupported additional subclaims withdrawn; the first-order mechanism reconnects after the actual local corrections.

counterevidence_and_rejected_candidates: A contour containing zero may still separate negative from positive eigenvalues; not a defect.
The qualitative DET remark does not itself supply quantitative derivative invertibility, but no assumption-compliant counterexample was established and it is not counted as a Problem.
Loss of A1-A4 at a numerical branch does not refute Theorem 4.
An omitted scalar environment energy is harmless for the density and not a finding.
Code-release absence is not a mathematical defect.
W2 contractions actually printed on physical43 agree with equation21 under R1; the claimed index counterexample is withdrawn.
Chemical-potential term on physical46 is already outside alpha; no factoring defect is supported.

severity_policy: No Major quota. Five groups are Minor because explicit local repairs were verified and reconnected to the core local and first-order proof; no unresolved substantive Major gap or counterexample to the main theorems was established.
